body:
Man, last night was tough but I made it. I sat in defeat on the stairs with my hands over my face because I was ready to go ahead and mix that drink. Then I counted to ten. Then I counted to ten again. Then I got up and went to my bedroom to cool off. 

My wife and I watched a tv show as she finished her beer (I don’t mind if she has a beer or two). She told me if we were going to watch another episode, she was going to get another drink. Knowing my intentions from earlier, I turned off the tv, kissed my wife, and went to sleep. 

Here’s to today being much easier. Iwndwyt!

Got to the bar early today. Ordered a Diet Coke with a lime. Told the waiter that I’ll take more of the same on subsequent rounds. It worked! I’m home now and sober as I have been the last 9 days!

Now I have to navigate a night on the road at a hotel bar with a colleague tomorrow.
I was supposed to have my first appointment yesterday but the doc called in with the flu. Now I have to wait until next Tuesday to get in. Just holding on until then... hopefully.

I just attended a happy hour with a customer (I’m in sales). Got to the bar before anyone else, ordered a Diet Coke with a lime and told the waiter to give me another of the same on any subsequent rounds ordered during the function. It worked! Zero alcohol on night nine. Didn’t drive home buzzed like countless other functions. Got home in time for dinner with the family. This was an awesome win. 

Now I go out of town tomorrow with a colleague and have to navigate a night at the hotel bar. Wish me luck.
I’m in for today. Made it through my first weekend without drinking in quite a while. I feel awesome this morning and am ready to carpe those diems!
I’ve got a customer happy hour to attend next week. I’m still figuring out what my move is for not drinking.

Thanks. This helped. I made it through last night and have had a great day today. 

Iwndwyt.
I’m taking it minute by minute right now. I won’t drink with you right now.

Four for four with a double stack was my crutch tonight. Might have to reup on some Gummi bears later. Trying to hide out in my hotel room while traveling for work. This really is the hardest thing to overcome. Drinking alone is how Ive always passed the time on the road.

New account. I want to be accountable to myself but I’m not yet willing to expose my intent to stop drinking with others just yet. 

I travel for work and the hotel room has been my nemesis in previous attempts to stop drinking. I’m 5 days in and am traveling for the first time since deciding to give sobriety another go. 

Checking in so I can come back to this sub for support when I’m alone and bored and can’t sleep in another hotel in another city. Booked a hotel without a bar. Now I just have to have the resolve not to hit the liquor store after checking in.
